meta.title: Checkout
meta.description: Sign in, add your billing details and pay on the payment provider’s hosted page. Keys are issued to your account after payment is confirmed.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.subtitle: Add a key to your cart to check out.

errors.checkFields: Check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

contact.title: Contact
contact.emailHint: Your receipt, invoice and key updates go to this address.

delivery.title: Billing details
delivery.billingHint: The address your card is registered to. It goes on your invoice.

review.title: Review and pay
review.accept: I have read and agree to the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and the <refunds>Refund policy</refunds>.
review.acceptLabelShort: Terms and Conditions and Refund policy
review.hosted: Pay takes you to the payment provider’s hosted page, where you enter your card details. They are never typed into this site.
review.processedBy: {provider} processes the card payment. We never see or store your full card number.
review.processedByProvider: Our PCI DSS compliant payment provider processes the card payment. We never see or store your full card number.
review.threeDs: Your bank may ask you to approve the payment in its app (3-D Secure).
review.waiverNote: We can’t issue keys without this request. Once a key is issued, the {days}-day right to cancel ends for it. <link>How cancelling works</link>.

merchant.tradingName: {brand} is a trading name of {company}. Company number {number}.

frame.credentials: {brand} is a trading name of {company}, company number {number}, {address}. {email}

paymentFailed.title: Your payment didn’t go through
paymentFailed.body: You haven’t been charged. Your details are still here, so you can try again.

problems.title: We couldn’t place this order
problems.PAYMENTS_NOT_CONNECTED: Card payments aren’t connected yet. Nothing has been charged.
problems.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Card payments aren’t available right now, so this order can’t be placed. Nothing has been charged. Try again later or email {email}.
problems.PAYMENT_LINK_FAILED: The payment page didn’t open. Nothing has been charged. Try again in a few minutes.
problems.TOTAL_CHANGED: A price or the exchange rate changed, so your total is now {total}. Check it and choose Pay again.
problems.ORDER_LIMIT: An order can hold up to {max} keys. Remove some to continue.
problems.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: {name} is no longer in stock. Remove it from your cart to continue.
problems.PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn’t confirm the price and stock of {name}. Nothing has been charged. Try again in a moment.
problems.AGE_REQUIRED: You need to be {minAge} or over to order. Add your date of birth in Account → Profile, then come back. Nothing has been charged.
problems.INVALID_REQUEST: Some details are missing or not valid. Check each step and try again.
problems.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
problems.UNAUTHORISED: You’ve been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
problems.NETWORK: We couldn’t reach the store. Check your connection and try again.
problems.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing has been charged. Try again.
problems.ITEM_LIMIT: An order can hold up to {max} keys of {name}. Lower the quantity to continue.
problems.ORDER_VALUE_LIMIT: An order can be worth up to {value}. Remove some keys to continue.
problems.CUSTOMER_LIMIT: To protect cardholders, {type} are limited to {max} keys or {value} per customer every 24 hours. Nothing has been charged.

meta.title: Order confirmation
meta.description: Where your Keyterminus order and payment are now.

confirmed.when: Your keys appear in Account → Keys, {usual}. We email you when they’re ready.

checking.title: Payment received
checking.body: We’re confirming the payment with the payment provider. It usually takes a few seconds. Keep this page open.

failed.title: Your payment didn’t go through
failed.body: You haven’t been charged. Your keys are still in your cart, so you can try again or use another card.
failed.help: If money has left your account, email {email} and we’ll look into it.

pending.title: Your payment isn’t confirmed yet
pending.body: Your bank hasn’t confirmed the payment yet. Please don’t pay again. We’ll email {email} as soon as it’s confirmed; if you hear nothing, contact {support}.

review.title: We’re checking your payment
review.body: The confirmed payment doesn’t match this order, so we’ve held it before issuing any key. We’ll contact you at {email} {replyTime}.

unavailable.title: We can’t confirm this payment right now
unavailable.body: The payment provider can’t be reached, so the order isn’t marked as paid yet. We’ll email {email} once it’s confirmed, or contact {support}.

missing.title: No order to show
missing.body: This page shows your order after you pay. If you’ve just paid, use the link in your confirmation email or open your orders.

error.title: We couldn’t load this order
error.notFound: We can’t find an order for this payment.
error.generic: Something went wrong while checking the payment.
error.body: Nothing is lost. Try again in a moment, or email {email} with the time you paid.

signIn.title: Sign in to check out
signIn.body: Your keys are kept in your account, so you’ll need one to receive them. Your cart stays as it is while you sign in.
